name: B10-0424/2026 – After recital B – Am 122
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: Bd. whereas the Parliamentary Assembly of the Council of Europe (CoE) has expressed its deep concern about the threat posed by hate speech, which dehumanises individuals and groups it targets, making them more vulnerable to stigmatisation, discrimination and violence; whereas according to the CoE, hate speech erodes the social fabric and hinders peaceful coexistence in diversity, produces a feeling of exclusion among minority groups and can contribute to alienation, marginalisation, the emergence of parallel societies and, ultimately, radicalisation; whereas hate speech, when used in political debate, becomes a barrier to constructive dialogue between political forces and undermines democratic values;
